description: Query commercial seaports from the NGA World Port Index (~3,800 ports worldwide). Each row carries port name, country, harbor size (Large/Medium/Small/Very Small), harbor type, shelter rating, channel depth in metres, repair facilities. Use for questions like "ports near Bab-el-Mandeb", "deepwater ports in West Africa", "all large harbors in the Mediterranean". Pass harbor_size to slice to a single tier.

harbor_size.description: Large | Medium | Small | Very Small. Filter optional.

name: query_ports
